answer: Because the timing is written down against the mesa challenge, the bridge audit can replay the copper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 49 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The per-identity price is 8 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
